description: Voice over IP communications are not protected against eavesdropping or manipulation. This signal indicates that voice communications may be intercepted or modified in transit.
applicability: Applicable to all VoIP implementations. Includes SIP encryption, SRTP for media streams, VoIP network segmentation, and voice traffic protection.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through VoIP configuration review, voice encryption verification, and SIP security assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
